<h3 class="card-title">MutationRx: Deciding Which Docking Hits to Believe</h3>
<p class="card-text text-muted small">Built with Claude: Life Sciences (Anthropic × Gladstone) · FastAPI · Docking · MCP</p>

<p class="card-text text-muted small">NANDAHack (MIT Media Lab) · Bayesian Inference · TrustRank · FastAPI</p>
